# Web Application Development

Fixture Corp designs and builds custom web applications, customer portals and ERP style business systems.
The backend stack commonly uses Python with Django or FastAPI, and relational databases such as PostgreSQL.

## Maintenance

After launch the company offers support plans covering bug fixes, security updates and small feature requests.
